original_card.question: Can one precisely specified helper-mixing word satisfy a replacement for the inherited H2/K interface?
methods: Derive a replacement interface lemma and price its implementation.
Seek an exact dirty-input or chronological-cut counterexample to the proposed replacement.
original_card.acceptance_gate: A full boundary contract and paid profile; unchanged scalar counts alone are insufficient.

first_step.inspect: Compare the two false H2/K flags with the unchanged paid profile in its README.
first_step.scope: Positive control / source-bound orientation only; this is not a new construction or full cold replay.

original_card.first_experiment: Write one replacement H2/K implication for a single helper-star operation, then try to falsify it on dirty inputs.
original_card.bottleneck_link: A legitimate replacement could admit a cheaper bit circuit; scalar savings alone do not alter the selected moment.
allowed_variations: Choose one helper-star or quartet instance; narrow to one boundary implication.
scope_change_triggers: Changing only source count or scalar addition count without an interface argument.

actual_scope: Independent audit of Lemma CR2 and Theorem B2 of PR 2162 (research/char2-jets section 2.1-2.2), item 2 of the open independent-check request in discussion 1166 comment 18934590: written re-derivation of Lemma GR/CR2/B2 plus an exact smallest-falsifying-instance-first search over a declared small-configuration domain for corollaries (i)-(ii) and both readings of the general bound (iii), with positive fixtures and failure controls.
scope_change_reason: Taking the explicit open request from the handoffs thread instead of the drawn card. The drawn bit-helper-contract object (a helper-mixing word with an H2/K replacement interface) is covered by existing packages (research/r439-copyshare-h2sem-admission, research/bit-copy-live-stabilizer, research/bit-live-copy-operator-intertwiner and others found by find_overlap.py at entry) and by PR 2193, whose body records the same coverage finding for its own bit-helper-contract draw. The request item was live and unclaimed (items 1 and 4 closed by PR 2193 and PR 2176, item 3 by PR 2272; items 2 and 5 open, and no Lean toolchain is installed here).
bottleneck_link: Side result: CR2/B2 underlie the T <= 3 case of the rank-3 decoder cost floor (A); the decoder floor bounds the line-decoder lever (C <= 29 per discussion 2278). Independent verification of those lemmas protects the floor arguments the lever map relies on. No kappa claim and no supplier change.
stop_rule: Declared domain (v in 4..7, entries in {-2,-1,1,2}, 58 exact instances with frozen receipt) fully enumerated, or the smallest falsifier found first. A null result is a scoped verification, not an impossibility theorem.
evidence: No falsifier in the declared domain; one statement/proof gap recorded: the MAS term of Theorem B2 (iii) is proven in the vertex form masV, while the literal edge form masE is strictly stronger, survived exact testing (two tight instances) and is not implied by the printed proof. open_questions.question: Does the edge form cost(B) >= v - |H| - |F| + masE hold in general?
open_questions.why_it_matters: It is strictly stronger than the printed Theorem B2 (iii) and survived exact testing on 58 instances, twice with equality; a proof would upgrade (iii) with no new machinery.
open_questions.first_step: Extend the dense cross-product wild-core family to v = 5, 6 partial cores and run a branch-and-bound minimum-cost search at larger free counts.
open_questions.blocked_by: Exact enumeration past free ~ 18 needs branch-and-bound or a SAT oracle; a complete wild digraph on four full-support lines is impossible over Q^3.

open_questions.question: Is there a wild-cycle configuration violating the vertex form v - |H| - |F| + masV (equivalently the Theorem B2 X-form)?
open_questions.why_it_matters: A violation would falsify Theorem B2 itself; none appeared in the 10 tested wild-cycle instances.
open_questions.first_step: Targeted search over structured v = 8 wild-cycle cores with free <= 18.
open_questions.blocked_by: Same enumeration cost; larger v increases 2^free faster than the caps allow.
